desc:
Dr Eggman's Robot has captured everyone into blocks 🫢

1. Break the blocks before it catches you! 🤖
2. Free the characters! ✨
3. Bring them back to your plot to earn cash! 💰

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍

And remember, your characters generate money when you're offline! 🤑

TIP: Mobile and Console players, use shiftlock to help aim crusher!

CODE: ZONETWO

Tags: Sonic, Steal, Collecting, Simulator, Tycoon, Towers, Egg, Break, Lucky Block
